I visited this restaurant for dinner. The staff were humble, polite, and welcoming. However, there are a few areas that need improvement.

To my knowledge, there is no elevator to reach the restaurant, which can make it difficult for elderly guests. The staff could also benefit from additional training to handle the weekend rush more efficiently.

Biggest concern was hygiene, which seemed below the standard. The food was also disappointing, the flavors didn't feel authentic or comparable to other Beijing Bites outlets I've visited in Bangalore. Based on my experience, this branch has noticeable hygiene and taste issues that should be addressed.
All the food was delicious and served in quick time. Especially Lazrash served with care and interest and gave suggestions to help with choosing right dish

One of the worst dining experiences I’ve ever had. The food was absolutely terrible—bland, poorly cooked, and tasted far from fresh. Every dish was disappointing, and it felt like no effort was put into either the quality or presentation.For the prices they charge, this place is a complete waste of money. I genuinely regret dining here and would strongly advise others to avoid it.

Food is very good but service is really slow as they don't have enough people be prepared for delay if you are going for dine in. No proper serving even they didn't give a main course after waiting 2 hrs we had to cancel at last.
But no complain with the food that was served and it was tasty as well . Owner should really look into the service part.

Booked a table on 15th May via district app for 9pm. Resturant was understaffed with on 2 folks taking and serving order. No one on front desk to allocate the table. We had to find the server and for allocating a table, he told us that any item will take minimum 30 min to serve. Then again waiting, one couple went up and the resturant could not even clean it and allocate it to us. We had to again ask them and after 2 or 3 times they cleaned it. All through they were not interested to even bother to attend us, ask us, seems like they would have been happy to not see any further customer coming along. Very poor experience, went for dinner but had to cancel the booking and head to Third Wave for coffee and sandwich instead. Alaways a go to for chinese food but the dinning exp at this outlet was very very poor.
